title: Fists (skill)

infobox.Description: Determines damage with Bare Fists and, Fist, weapons.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Fists is a skill related to Fists weapon class, including Bare fists.

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
Higher skill level in fists reduces the stamina cost to attack down to -33% and increases damage and knockback up to +141%.
For the details of damage scaling, see Damage mechanics#Skill factor.

sections.heading: Leveling up
sections.text: The player gains 1.5xp per one-handed and 1xp per two-handed attack when hitting a creature.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Skill ID is Unarmed (to use with raiseskill or resetskill commands).
• Fists was previously named Unarmed prior to the Frost Caves update.

full_text:
Fists (skill)

Description: Determines damage with Bare Fists and, Fist, weapons.

Introduction. Fists is a skill related to Fists weapon class, including Bare fists.

Effects. Higher skill level in fists reduces the stamina cost to attack down to -33% and increases damage and knockback up to +141%.
For the details of damage scaling, see Damage mechanics#Skill factor.

Leveling up. The player gains 1.5xp per one-handed and 1xp per two-handed attack when hitting a creature.

Notes. • Skill ID is Unarmed (to use with raiseskill or resetskill commands).
• Fists was previously named Unarmed prior to the Frost Caves update.
